title: Leray homology comparison over any base with exact global sections
statement: Let t:Y -> T be a scheme morphism, and suppose the global sections functor on abelian etale sheaves of T preserves finite colimits (it already preserves finite limits). For any bounded-below complex K on Y and integer q there is a canonical isomorphism Gamma(T,H^q(Rt_*K)) -> H^q(Y,K). It is the composite of the exact-functor homology isomorphism, the identification of the derived exact global-sections functor with the induced functor, bounded-below/unbounded compatibility, and the canonical derived direct-image/global-sections composition isomorphism. No geometric-point or particular strict-local model is part of this construction.

source.place: Tag 03Q9, theorem-higher-direct-images, proof and remark-stalk-fibre; Tag 03QO for exact global sections

proof.text: Install the given finite-colimit-preservation instance for global sections. Use Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso and rightDerivedFunctorPlusIsoMapDerivedCategoryPlus to identify global sections of homology with homology of derived global sections.

Apply bounded-below/unbounded derived-functor compatibility, then rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso for t, and map the resulting composite isomorphism by the degree-q homology functor. Every factor is fixed canonically; the result is a concrete isomorphism, not a choice from an existence proposition.
